Leaflet 1.9.4 JavaScript/CSS, downloaded from the public versioned distribution:
https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js
https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css
License inspected before reuse:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/v1.9.4/LICENSE
The included LICENSE retains the BSD-2-Clause notice.

Vendored to keep browser scripts local and avoid a runtime CDN dependency.
This general mapping library is used independently of All Sky Alert detector code.
No marker image assets are needed: the application uses circle markers and paths.
When upgrading, inspect/revalidate license, CSP compatibility and mobile map QA.
Source-map files are not included or needed for normal operation.
